mainTopic: The two kinds of documents, גט פשוט (ordinary) and גט מקושר (tied): where the witnesses sign, how many are needed, and the פסוק these two kinds come from.
overview: This amud opens a new פרק with a משנה about two kinds of legal documents. In a גט פשוט, an ordinary flat document, the witnesses sign inside, under the writing, and two witnesses are needed. In a גט מקושר, a folded and tied document, the witnesses sign on the back, and three are needed. If the signing places are swapped, or a document has fewer witnesses than it needs, it is פסול. רבי חנינא בן גמליאל holds that a מקושר signed inside is still כשר, because it can be untied and treated as a פשוט. רבן שמעון בן גמליאל says it all depends on local custom. The גמרא then asks where these two kinds of documents come from. רבי חנינא answers with a פסוק in ירמיהו and starts explaining its first half. That explanation continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Where the witnesses sign on each type of document
steps.stepSummary: The משנה opens: in a גט פשוט the witnesses sign inside, and in a גט מקושר they sign on the back.
steps.simpleTranslation: An ordinary document has its witnesses sign inside it. A tied document has its witnesses sign on its back.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה introduces two kinds of documents and tells us where the witnesses sign on each one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A גט פשוט is a regular flat document. Its witnesses sign on the written side, under the text. A גט מקושר is a folded and tied document, and its witnesses sign on the back. Everything else in this משנה builds on this basic difference.

keyTerms.meaning: Here: any legal document, not only a divorce document
Tied (a document that is folded and tied)

steps.confusionAlert: In this פרק, גט does not mean a divorce document. It means any legal document, such as a sale or a loan.

phrases.english: An ordinary document: its witnesses sign inside it.
phrases.notes: "Inside" means on the same side as the writing.

phrases.english: A tied document: its witnesses sign on its back.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: Witnesses of a פשוט sign inside; witnesses of a מקושר sign on the back.

steps.title: Switching the signing place makes both documents invalid
steps.stepSummary: A פשוט signed on the back, or a מקושר signed inside, is פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: An ordinary document signed on its back, and a tied document signed inside, are both invalid.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה tells us what happens if the witnesses sign in the wrong place: both documents are invalid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 1 was not just advice. Each kind of document must be signed in its own correct place. If you swap the two places, the document is פסול.

phrases.english: An ordinary document whose witnesses wrote their signatures on its back,
and a tied document whose witnesses wrote their signatures inside it,
both of them are invalid.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the result of breaking the rule from step 1
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Swapping the signing places makes both documents פסול.

steps.title: A tied document signed inside is still valid
steps.stepSummary: רבי חנינא בן גמליאל holds that a מקושר signed inside is כשר, because it can be turned into a פשוט.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי חנינא בן גמליאל says: a tied document signed inside is valid, because you can turn it into an ordinary document.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי חנינא בן גמליאל disagrees with part of step 2. He holds that a מקושר signed inside is valid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: His reason is that you can untie the מקושר and treat it as a פשוט. A פשוט is signed inside anyway, so the signatures are in the right place for that kind. He does not argue about the other case, a פשוט signed on its back.

phrases.english: Rabbi Chanina ben Gamliel says:
A tied document whose witnesses wrote inside it is valid,
because one can make it into an ordinary document.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disagrees with half of the first opinion's ruling
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A מקושר signed inside is כשר, since it can become a פשוט.

steps.title: Everything follows local custom
steps.stepSummary: רבן שמעון בן גמליאל says the rules depend on the custom of each place.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבן שמעון בן גמליאל says: everything follows the custom of the region.
steps.whatsHappening: A third opinion: רבן שמעון בן גמליאל says there is no fixed rule. Each place follows its own custom.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to him, the custom of the region decides which kind of document people use and how they sign it. A document that follows the local practice is acceptable.

phrases.english: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says:
Everything is according to the custom of the region.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A third view on the dispute
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The form of the document follows local custom.

steps.title: How many witnesses each document needs
steps.stepSummary: A פשוט needs two witnesses and a מקושר needs three. Fewer makes either one פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: An ordinary document needs two witnesses, and a tied document needs three. An ordinary document with one witness, or a tied document with two witnesses, is invalid.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה adds a second difference between the two documents: the number of witnesses each one needs.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A פשוט needs at least two witnesses. A מקושר needs at least three. If either document has one witness fewer than its minimum, it is פסול.
steps.whatToRemember: Remember the two differences. פשוט: witnesses sign inside, and two are needed. מקושר: witnesses sign on the back, and three are needed.

phrases.english: An ordinary document: its witnesses are two,
and a tied document: three.
An ordinary document on which one witness signed,
and a tied document on which two witnesses signed,
both of them are invalid.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second rule about the same two documents
steps.mimraCoreRuling: פשוט needs two witnesses; מקושר needs three.

steps.title: Where do these two kinds of documents come from
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source of these laws.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: From where do we know these things?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins by asking where we learn that there are two kinds of documents.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question looks for a source in the פסוקים. The idea of having two different kinds of documents, each with its own rules, needs a basis.

keyTerms.meaning: From where are these things learned?

phrases.english: Gemara: From where are these matters derived?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the משנה
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source in the פסוקים for having two kinds of documents

steps.title: רבי חנינא brings a verse from ירמיהו
steps.stepSummary: רבי חנינא quotes ירמיהו 32:44 as the source.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי חנינא said: because the verse says, 'They shall buy fields for money, and write it in a document, and seal it, and call witnesses.'
steps.whatsHappening: רבי חנינא answers the question by quoting a פסוק about buying fields with written documents.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק mentions two actions: writing a document, and sealing it. The גמרא will read these as hints to two different kinds of documents.
steps.confusionAlert: This רבי חנינא in the גמרא is a different speaker from רבי חנינא בן גמליאל in the משנה.

phrases.english: Rabbi Chanina said: As the verse states:
"They shall buy fields for money,"
"and write in the document and seal it,"
"and call witnesses."

steps.title: Starting to break down the first part of the verse
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא repeats the first part of the פסוק to begin explaining it.
steps.simpleTranslation: "They shall buy fields for money and write in the document":
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the first half of the פסוק again. This sets up the next move, where it will explain what this half refers to.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גמרא is splitting the פסוק into parts so it can match each part to one kind of document. This line opens that explanation, and the explanation continues after this point.

phrases.english: "They shall buy fields for money and write in the document":

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins explaining the פסוק just quoted
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Begins mapping the first half of the פסוק onto one kind of document
